name: Slag Crawler
desc: A long, armored creature from the lava tubes, which eats heat and isn't fussy about whose.

intro: The wall of the lava tube moves. A long body of cooled slag drags itself out, and you feel the warmth go out of the air around you.
Your breath suddenly fogs, in a tunnel hot enough to cook in. Something long turns toward the warmth of you.
hit: Mandibles crusted with slag close on your arm, and the cold runs right up to your shoulder.
Its tail whips through the heavy air and knocks your legs out from under you.
It presses its glowing underside against you, and you feel it drink the warmth from your whole side.
miss: It strikes where you were standing, and leaves a bite-shaped hole in solid rock.
You drag yourself clear, every step heavy in this gravity, and the mandibles close behind you.
It lunges at you and overshoots, and its segments grind past you in a shower of hot grit.
crit: It wraps around you, and everything warm in you starts to leave, and you've never been so cold.
defeated: The glow fades along its seams, segment by segment, until you're looking at a long heap of slag.
It curls up and cracks, and the heat it stole rolls back over you in one great breath.
joins: A seam in the rock beside you splits open, and {enemy} pours out of it, glowing.
stunned: {Enemy} coils in on itself with its seams dimming, and loses track of you.
